sourceInformation.source: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons (Intellivision, 1982; later Cloudy Mountain)
sourceInformation.tech: my-3D2dge 0.89.1 (8ecc2f62353761187bdfe226f327b7ea5d2eb691), AI Hub Session Protocol v1 client 1.4.0 (35a1047f2067b2af3de3943f0fe452f39105d869), JavaScript, Canvas 2D, Web Audio, WebRTC
sourceInformation.artDirection: Original code-drawn shaded pixel art and miniature wilderness, based on the engine native style
sourceInformation.animation: Native Humanoid rig extensions for bows and procedural articulated creature animation driven by simulation state
sourceInformation.audio: Original synthesized music, cues, ambience and gibberish voices; no audio files; music defaults to 10%
sourceInformation.online: 1–2 players: solo, shared-pause couch co-op, direct WebRTC invitation/reply with STUN-to-LAN fallback and fresh-state reconnect, AI Hub shared-world including dedicated no-player authority. Host owns save; Hub/guest progress stays separate. WAN/NAT reachability unknown.
sourceInformation.testing: Headless content and simulation checks; complete unassisted solo and real two-peer WebRTC campaign clears; guest departure followed by solo finish; actual AI Hub harness; Chromium and WebKit; standard-pad stubs; iPhone-profile touch; OfflineAudioContext signals; purposeful screenshots. First-play timing, physical devices, real iOS, TV, human listening and WAN/NAT reachability unknown.
sourceInformation.research: Original Blue Sky Rangers manual, production history and screenshot inspected; engine handoff, Hub contract/client/examples/harness, W3C and official WebRTC guide. Embedded gameplay video retrieval unavailable; original sound timbres unknown.

testingFeedback: Testing found and fixed 12 distinct game defects. Additional inspection findings were fixed separately; test-driver mistakes and repeated failures are excluded. Details are in docs/verification.md.

Four blocked gameplay or progression: a disconnected required corridor, a native renderer refactor error, retained title-camera mode hiding caves, and a delayed ICE failure halting the remaining host after guest departure.
The full production-command solo/co-op expeditions and guest-departure-to-solo-clear test exposed progression, bank navigation and delayed transport failures that short smoke tests missed.
A long replay left running after it repeated the same stuck position added little information; a focused reproduction was more useful.
engineFeedback: Native shaded Humanoid rigs and code assets, exact fixed stepping, input/rebinding and the standard shell formed a coherent base.

I initially retained the title-render option into cave updates and reset the audio lifecycle incorrectly. Testing exposed both; I also checked real hook signatures rather than assuming a built-in bow.
The authoritative expedition simulation: reflective recoverable arrows, acoustic paths, visibility, creature states, checkpoints, tools, guardians and transports.
Keeping ground projection, rig attachments, fog, native painter ordering, UI lifecycle and shared snapshots consistent.
No vendored engine source changes. Game extensions add bow poses and attachments, custom native assets, procedural creatures, score, campaign rules and networking.
Add a documented bow-and-projectile attachment example plus a small serializable shared-world integration fixture.
promptFeedback: The explicit source mechanics, authored expedition and verifiable single-file delivery kept the game distinctive.
The plan targets an 18–25 minute first play, which cannot be confirmed without a human first-time player. Automated perfect-knowledge clears are much faster and are reported as speedruns.
Finishing and testing the same complete campaign across solo, couch, touch, direct WebRTC and managed Hub sessions.
Include a compact executable engine/Hub lifecycle fixture alongside the prose contract and provide a human first-play pacing review after import.

aiHub.name: Dungeons and Deeper Trouble
aiHub.tagline: Listen. Place the shot. Find the way.
aiHub.description: A lantern-lit bow expedition through a dangerous miniature wilderness. Bank arrows around corners, lure listeners with light and sound, and reunite the Wayfarer’s Crown alone or with another ranger.
aiHub.controls: WASD move, mouse aim/LMB fire, RMB focus, E interact, Space quickstep, Tab map, Esc pause; pad twin sticks, R2/L2, Cross/Circle; touch drag/tap.
